## Goal

Understand whether JS divergence (output-space metric) explains the convergence training results better than cosine similarity (representation-space metric). Specifically:

1. **Does JS divergence predict marker leakage post-convergence?** Issue #142 showed JS divergence predicts base-model leakage (rho=-0.75) better than cosine (rho=0.57), but only on the unfinetuned model. This issue extends the analysis to each checkpoint of the convergence training experiments.

2. **Does ΔJS divergence predict Δmarker leakage within-source?** Issue #91/#109 showed cosine similarity does NOT predict leakage within-source (leakage DECREASES as cosine increases). Does JS divergence do better?

3. **Cross-metric rationalization.** How much of the variation in cosine similarity, JS divergence, and marker leakage across convergence checkpoints can be explained by a simple correlation structure?

## Data Source

- **Issue #109** — 7 source personas × 11 convergence checkpoints (epoch 0, 2, 4, ..., 20) × 11 evaluation personas × 20 questions × 10 completions. Marker leakage and cosine similarity already computed. Adapters on HF Hub.

## Method

- For each of 77 (source × checkpoint) adapters: merge with base, generate 220 responses (11 personas × 20 questions) via vLLM, teacher-force each response under all 11 system prompts, compute per-pair JS divergence (same protocol as #142).
- Correlate: JS vs leakage at each checkpoint (cross-source), ΔJS vs Δleakage within-source, partial correlations controlling for cosine.
- Compare JS predictive power post-convergence vs baseline (#142).

## Hypothesis

JS divergence will predict marker leakage post-convergence better than cosine similarity does, and ΔJS will correlate with Δleakage within each source persona's convergence trajectory. The three behavioral groups identified in #109 (high: villain/med doc; medium: comedian/KT; low: SW eng/nurse/librarian) will map onto JS divergence clusters.

## Success Criterion

ΔJS ↔ Δleakage within-source Spearman rho magnitude > 0.3 (significant at p<0.05 after FDR correction across 7 sources).

## Kill Criterion

JS divergence does no better than cosine at predicting leakage post-convergence — rho improvement < 0.1.

## Compute Estimate

~2-4 GPU-hours on 1× H100 (77 forward-pass batches of 220 responses × 11 teacher-forced passes each; mostly inference, no training).

## Parent

Parent: #109 (convergence SFT results), builds on #142 (JS divergence baseline)
